decks.create: INSERT INTO decks (id, name, active_version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, NULL, ?, ?)
decks.get_by_id: SELECT d.id, d.name, d.active_version, d.created_at, d.updated_at, v.status AS active_status, v.has_thumb AS active_has_thumb, (SELECT MAX(version_no) FROM deck_versions WHERE deck_id = d.id) AS latest_version FROM decks d LEFT JOIN deck_versions v ON v.deck_id = d.id AND v.version_no = d.active_version WHERE d.id = ?
decks.list_ready_latest: SELECT d.id, d.name, d.active_version, d.created_at, d.updated_at, v.status AS active_status, v.has_thumb AS active_has_thumb, (SELECT MAX(version_no) FROM deck_versions WHERE deck_id = d.id) AS latest_version FROM decks d JOIN deck_versions v ON v.deck_id = d.id AND v.version_no = d.active_version WHERE v.status = 'ready' ORDER BY d.created_at DESC, d.id DESC
decks.set_active: UPDATE decks SET active_version = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?

deck_versions.create: INSERT INTO deck_versions (deck_id, version_no, status, has_thumb, idempotency_key, error_message, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, 'processing', 0, ?, NULL, ?, ?)
deck_versions.get: SELECT * FROM deck_versions WHERE deck_id = ? AND version_no = ?
deck_versions.list_by_deck: SELECT * FROM deck_versions WHERE deck_id = ? ORDER BY version_no ASC
deck_versions.max_version: SELECT MAX(version_no) AS n FROM deck_versions WHERE deck_id = ?
deck_versions.update_status: UPDATE deck_versions SET status = ?, error_message = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE deck_id = ? AND version_no = ?
deck_versions.update_thumb: UPDATE deck_versions SET has_thumb = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE deck_id = ? AND version_no = ?
deck_versions.delete_one: DELETE FROM deck_versions WHERE deck_id = ? AND version_no = ?
